comments.text:
The walrus refers to through the looking glass poem, the walrus and the carpenter where they befriend all the oysters and then eat them all. A genocide story full of old testament, and genocide references. See how they run like pigs from a gun..boer war..goo goo cachew, crying because there are no more to kill..It is an admission of the Beatles role in destroying the youth, the whole purpose of the counter culture. In a 1980 playboy interview he said he should have said he was the carpenter but it wouldn't sound right.
Carpenter is another term for freemason. In the Greek, tekton..architect..builder. Lennon said he didn't want to be a craftsman anymore. Chapman was found with Catcher in the Rye..like Hinckley. It is a book that has cryptic 
Freemasonry undertones all through it. See Joseph Atwill's, Freemason in the Rye. He doubts Lennon wrote it because he wouldn't know the underlying details. Oh, and by the way..who was a famous carpenter?
Out of Egypt I call my son...
See Ralph Ellis.
